_comment: What runs where. The manager seeds this into the signed drive at /assignments.json; each worker replicates it and looks up its own name to learn which role(s) to pull + run. A value may be a single role or an array. 5.2: worker-a is assigned BOTH echo and reverse — it serves each on its own named protomux channel over one connection (multi-role-per-worker). Edit + re-seed to re-place responsibilities.
